answers.core:
It technically can be an add-on in the asset library but this is such a low level thing, that it just makes more sense to have it in core. Also since add-ons cannot change core APIs the call would then look something like 

```gdscript
NodeUtils.clear(_result_list)
```
which is still nicer than the for-loop but not as nice as:

```gdscript
_result_list.clear()
```
answers.workaround: It can be worked around with a few lines of script but this is a simple convenience function that will streamline a use case that happens pretty frequently.
